source_registry.description: Registry of anatomical reference data sources for deterministic reconstruction

nhanes.name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
nhanes.notes: Primary source for US anthropometric data. Publicly available.

who_database.name: WHO Global Database on Body Mass Index

drillis_contini_1966.name: Body Segment Parameters
drillis_contini_1966.publisher: New York University, School of Engineering and Science, Technical Report 1166.03
drillis_contini_1966.reproduced_in: Winter, D.A. (2009). Biomechanics and Motor Control of Human Movement, 4th ed., Wiley, Fig. 4.1
drillis_contini_1966.coverage: Segment lengths and joint heights as fractions of stature H
drillis_contini_1966.notes: Population means; body-dimension definitions were not formalised by the authors. The 1972 Part II report (Contini) quotes slightly different arm ratios (0.189/0.145/0.128H); this project uses the Winter Fig. 4.1 set (0.186/0.146/0.108H) consistently.

isb_recommendations.name: International Society of Biomechanics Standards
isb_recommendations.notes: Standard recommendations for joint centers and coordinate systems.

trotter_1970.name: Estimation of stature from intact long limb bones
trotter_1970.coverage: Male white long-bone stature regressions (WWII / Korean War)

trotter_gleser_1952.name: Estimation of stature from long bones of American Whites and Negroes
trotter_gleser_1952.coverage: Female (and male 1952) long-bone stature regressions, Terry Collection

forensic_anthropology.name: Forensic Anthropology Reference Collections
forensic_anthropology.notes: Needed to replace ESTIMATE midshaft diameters used only for proxy meshes.

classical_proportions.name: Classical Proportion Systems
classical_proportions.notes: Historical proportion systems for validation reference.

anthropometric_averages.description: Placeholder anthropometric averages for reconstruction testing

joint_center_offsets.description: Placeholder joint center offsets for reconstruction testing

critical: Joint center definitions for major joints
missing: Population profile beyond adult male 20-40 y
Depth/width data other than shoulder and hip breadth

HAND_SEGMENT_PROPORTIONS: carpus / metacarpal / phalanx length split per ray, ray spacing and thumb orientation (e.g. Buryanov & Kotiuk 2010 phalangeal proportions; hand-breadth tables such as ANSUR II). NOT_ACQUIRED - the canonical hand (finding A10, docs/audit/A10_HAND_LAYOUT.md) uses PLACEHOLDER proportions 2:4:3 and 0.0133 m spacing taken from the pre-existing data, scaled to the PROVEN wrist-fingertip length (0.108 H, DRILLIS_CONTINI_1966).

FOREARM_INTEROSSEOUS_WIDTH: radius-ulna centre separation at elbow and wrist in the anatomical position. NOT_ACQUIRED - finding A11 (docs/audit/A11_FOREARM_LAYOUT.md) keeps the pre-existing PLACEHOLDER 0.0666 m separation, moved from the antero-posterior (Y) to the lateral (X) axis.
